analysis_exposure: Retrospective matched factorial. Restormer C040 results existed before this analysis freeze; NAFNet and MPRNet C040 outputs did not. This is not a new prospective independent confirmation.
claim_boundary: Inference is limited to NAFNet, MPRNet, and Restormer under the matched C040 synthetic low/mid/high degradation protocol. It does not establish backbone interchangeability, all-architecture dominance, real-field detection efficacy, or natural physical-width accuracy.

factorial_estimands.backbone_main_effect: largest absolute pairwise contrast between backbone marginal means, averaged over base and MERIT arms
factorial_estimands.dominance_margin: framework main effect minus largest backbone marginal contrast
factorial_estimands.factor_sums_of_squares: framework, backbone, and interaction sums of squares from the 3x2 cell means
factorial_estimands.framework_main_effect: mean over backbones of MERIT minus base

independent_unit: physical parent; crops, model seeds, and the fixed degradation draw are averaged within parent before paired bootstrap
objective: Test whether the final MERIT framework configuration has a larger matched PSNR-gain effect than restoration-backbone choice.
primary_endpoint: PSNR(output, clean) - PSNR(identical degraded source, clean), in dB
reporting_rule: Report PASS or FAIL without changing routes, seeds, cohort, estimands, or gates after C050 output. Preserve interaction and failed-cell results.
